        assert config.d_model % config.n_heads == 0

        self.W_k = nn.Linear(config.d_model, self.d_attention * config.n_heads)
        self.W_q = nn.Linear(config.d_model, self.d_attention * config.n_heads)

title: Implement scaled dot-product attention and multi-head attention
instruction_text: In UvA Deep Learning Tutorial 6: Transformers and Multi-Head Attention, implement the contiguous attention module section covering scaled dot-product attention and multi-head attention. Specifically, complete or reproduce the attention computation from the section beginning with 'Scaled Dot Product Attention' and continuing through the Multi-Head Attention implementation. The task includes computing attention logits from queries and keys, applying scaling and masking, normalizing with softmax, combining values, expanding masks to compatible dimensions, and implementing the MultiheadAttention module that projects Q/K/V, splits heads, applies scaled dot-product attention, concatenates heads, and applies the output projection.
starter_code:
def scaled_dot_product(q, k, v, mask=None):
    d_k = q.size()[-1]
    attn_logits = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1))
    attn_logits = attn_logits / math.sqrt(d_k)
    if mask is not None:
        attn_logits = attn_logits.masked_fill(mask == 0, -9e15)
    attention = F.softmax(attn_logits, dim=-1)
    values = torch.matmul(attention, v)
    return values, attention


def expand_mask(mask):
    assert mask.ndim >= 2, "Mask must be at least 2-dimensional with seq_length x seq_length"
    if mask.ndim == 3:
        mask = mask.unsqueeze(1)
    while mask.ndim < 4:
        mask = mask.unsqueeze(0)
    return mask


class MultiheadAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, embed_dim, num_heads):
        super().__init__()
        assert embed_dim % num_heads == 0
        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = embed_dim // num_heads
        self.qkv_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, 3 * embed_dim)
        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(embed_dim, input_dim)
